description.description: A high-altitude mountain highway winds through a misty valley towards the Sonamarg Tunnel. Fog and low-hanging clouds cling to the steep, green mountain slopes. The road is well-maintained with clear markings and yellow-and-black hazard barriers. As the camera moves forward, it approaches the entrance of the 'Sonamarg Tunnel,' which is decorated with signage and flags.
